tagline.zh: Minecraft 创作者 & C# 开发者

subtitle.zh: 爱玩 Minecraft/CS：GO，喜欢建筑和 PVP，平时也用 C# 写桌面程序。这里是我的作品。
subtitle.en: Hi, I'm msmapwr. I play Minecraft, mostly building and PVP, and I write desktop programs in C#. Here are my projects.

paragraph.zh: 我是 msmapwr，一名学生，平时喜欢做游戏和桌面程序。
paragraph.en: I'm msmapwr, a student who likes making games and desktop programs.

paragraph.zh: 我玩 Minecraft，主要做建筑和场景，也打 PVP。编程上我用 C#，最近在学 WPF 和 WinUI。
paragraph.en: I play Minecraft, mostly building and scene work, plus some PVP. I program in C#, and I'm learning WPF and WinUI.

paragraph.zh: 我用AI做了网页策略桌游《第二绿洲》，从玩法到代码都是AI搞定。我喜欢把想法做成能跑起来的东西，然后继续学新的。
paragraph.en: I made The Second Oasis, a web strategy board game, on my own, from the rules to the code. I like turning ideas into things that run, then learning what's next.

tagline.zh: 月球领土争夺 · 回合制网页策略桌游 · 2～4 人对战
tagline.en: Lunar territory · turn-based web strategy board game · 2 to 4 players

description.zh: 《第二绿洲》是一款以月球殖民为背景的回合制网页策略游戏。玩家扮演不同国家的月球开发势力，在有限资源、随机事件与其他玩家的竞争中建立自己的领土。通过风险选择、开发链、抢夺与崩坏等机制，在终局结算中成为最大的月球势力。
description.en: The Second Oasis is a turn-based web strategy game about colonizing the moon. Each player runs a nation's lunar program, building territory with limited resources, random events, and other players in the way. Risk choices, development chains, and seize-and-collapse mechanics shape the game, and the largest lunar power wins at final settlement.

tagline.zh: Fluent Design 风格的个人作品集网站
tagline.en: A Fluent Design personal portfolio website

description.zh: 你现在看到的这个网站。用微软 Fluent Design 风格做中英双语作品集，用 React 和 Fluent UI React 搭建，托管在 GitHub Pages。
description.en: The site you're looking at. A bilingual portfolio in Microsoft's Fluent Design style, built with React and Fluent UI React and hosted on GitHub Pages.
